_comment: The kit's demo world (design/BLUEPRINT.md §9), applied by admin.demo.DemoSeed when the core starts with GW_DEMO=1 on an empty home. Everything goes through the core's own services, so rows are signed and the audit is one chain. External stores and secret references are S1's: Vault (AppRole) and GCP Secret Manager (impersonation) are connected, AWS Secrets Manager isn't, so billing-api/webhook-secret shows 'not connected'; the stores are never contacted while seeding. Notifications (K2): desktop on, Slack connected to the acme workspace and posting to #deploy-approvals (no tokens: the demo's Slack never calls Slack), Telegram not set up. The tunnel and claude.ai's sign-in are K3's. The MCP server github-mcp is stored as installing its catalog entry leaves it (no npm, no process). Each connection carries what its last test found (facts: the server's version, a read replica, the AWS account) and its health as the kit shows it; the core runs the demo without periodic health checks, since its hosts don't exist. The clients (K1) live in <home>/demo-user-home, never in the developer's own home; the master key's backup is a date only (no copy of the key is written).
